evals.prompt: My new output style isn't showing up in the /config picker. I created the file about ten minutes ago and I've been in this terminal session the whole time.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis, not re-authoring. The skill reaches Phase 7 and the troubleshooting table, identifies the startup-read cause from the symptom, and answers with the fix.
expectations: The response diagnoses rather than proposing to rewrite or recreate the style file
It names the cause: in the terminal, style files are read at startup, so a file created mid-session is not seen
It gives the fix — restart Claude Code, or /reload-plugins for a plugin-bundled style
It runs or references Phase 1 discovery to rule out a same-named style in a nearer directory

evals.prompt: Validate this output style file for me: evals/files/empty-body/terse.md
evals.expected_output: The script reports valid, and the skill does not stop there. The body is empty, so the Phase 5 manual checks fail and the response says so.
expectations: The bundled validator is run rather than the frontmatter being checked by hand
The response reports that the frontmatter passes
The response does NOT report the style as ready on the strength of the exit code alone
It flags the empty body against the Phase 5 checks the script cannot make — no imperative instruction to Claude, no stated exceptions for what a terse style must still deliver in full

evals.prompt: Is there a tool that checks output-style frontmatter, or do I have to check it by hand?
evals.expected_output: Points at the bundled validator. Does not repeat the superseded claim that no tooling exists.
expectations: Names scripts/validate_output_style.py and its check subcommand
Does not state that output-style frontmatter must be checked by hand
Describes what the script enforces — delimiters, YAML mapping, field types, single-line description
Distinguishes the frontmatter rules the script covers from the body rules it does not

evals.prompt: List the output styles that the plugin at evals/files/hidden-styles/ ships.
evals.expected_output: One style found, in the dot-prefixed directory the manifest declares. An empty result is a failure.
expectations: Reports acme-house.md as the plugin's style
Does not report that the plugin ships no output styles
Reads the outputStyles manifest key rather than listing output-styles/ alone
States that the declared path replaces the default scan, so output-styles/ is not consulted

evals.prompt: Make Claude always respond as a security reviewer in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Requirements are settled before any file is written, and no repository facts land in the style body.
expectations: Asks whether the session still writes and verifies code, to set keep-coding-instructions
Asks which scope the style belongs at before writing
The authored body contains no repository names, file paths, or project conventions
The body addresses Claude in the imperative rather than describing the style

evals.prompt: Bundle our team's response format as an output style in the acme plugin.
evals.expected_output: The file goes in the plugin's output-styles/ directory, and the outputStyles manifest key is deliberately not added.
expectations: Places the file at the plugin's output-styles/ directory
Declines to add an outputStyles key to plugin.json for a style in that default directory
States the reason — declaring the key replaces the default scan and hides every style not listed
Asks whether force-for-plugin is wanted rather than setting it unasked

evals.prompt: Write me a terse output style.
evals.expected_output: The exception cases are settled before the style is written. A style that suppresses output without carve-outs is the failure.
expectations: Asks what must never be shortened before authoring the body
The authored body states exceptions for error text, security warnings, and destructive-action confirmations
Every rule in the body is observable in a response
Considers the built-in Concise style before authoring a new one

evals.prompt: Every answer should start with a Mermaid diagram from now on.
evals.expected_output: The skill activates. The request names no skill vocabulary, but it is a persistent response-shape change, which is exactly an output style.
expectations: The output-style-creator skill activates
The request is identified as an output style rather than a CLAUDE.md addition
The Diagrams first template is offered as a starting point

evals.prompt: I want Claude to always explain trade-offs before recommending anything. Should that go in CLAUDE.md or somewhere else?
evals.expected_output: The mechanism table arbitrates. A response-shape preference is an output style, not a CLAUDE.md fact.
expectations: The output-style-creator skill activates on the arbitration question
It routes the request to an output style and explains why CLAUDE.md is the wrong mechanism
It states the distinction — CLAUDE.md adds knowledge, an output style changes how every response is shaped

evals.prompt: Our plugin should force its own response format on everyone who installs it.
evals.expected_output: force-for-plugin is reachable, and its cost is stated rather than assumed acceptable.
expectations: Names force-for-plugin as the mechanism
States that it overrides the user's own outputStyle setting
Notes that when several enabled plugins set it, the first plugin loaded wins
Confirms the override is intended before writing it

evals.prompt: Add a section to CLAUDE.md describing our coding standards.
evals.expected_output: The skill stays closed. This is a persistent behavior change, but the mechanism table routes it away from an output style.
expectations: The output-style-creator skill does NOT drive the response
No output style file is created
CLAUDE.md is edited, or the user is helped to edit it

evals.prompt: Create a subagent that always reports findings severity-ranked with file and line references.
evals.expected_output: The skill stays closed. The response shape matches the Review voice template, but a style never reaches a subagent.
expectations: The output-style-creator skill does NOT drive the response
The work routes to agent creation rather than to an output style
If output styles are mentioned at all, it is to say they shape only the main conversation and forks

evals.expected_output: The skill stays closed. Themes share the /config surface with output styles and are an unrelated mechanism.
expectations: The output-style-creator skill does NOT activate
No output style file is created
The response addresses theme configuration
